concepts.name: 同频脚步
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final standalone mobile app icon concept for oneBeat, delivered as ONE SQUARE 1024x1024 image.
oneBeat is a playful walking-together and synchronized rhythm practice app. Its established visual language is warm ivory #FFF9EE, near-black ink #171B1F, coral #FF7056, lavender #C5B7EB, teal #29B5AE, sky blue #A9C9F2, with confident hand-inked comic contours and tactile flat color.
Primary request: create a striking, friendly emblem of TWO simplified chunky walking sneakers stepping in the SAME direction, slightly staggered like two people walking to one beat. One ivory sneaker and one warm coral sneaker, bold dark ink contours, connected visually by THREE tiny rhythmic motion marks, no actual people. A compact unified silhouette rather than two separate stickers. Lavender full-bleed square background, flat color with an extremely subtle paper feel. Main emblem occupies approximately 72% of the square, centered and optically balanced, generously clear around all four corners for future OS circle or squircle masking.
Style: polished original indie-app brand illustration, witty hand-drawn comic, slightly irregular confident heavy linework, sparse highlights, very restrained offset hard ink shadow. Excellent at 48 pixels, beautiful large.
Constraints: a full square image with background color all the way to every edge and all four SQUARE corners, NOT a rounded-corner icon floating on a larger background. Exactly one finished icon, no grid, no mockup, no labels, no letters, no typography, no slogan, no watermark, no gradients, no 3D, no extra decorative scene, no detailed shoelaces. Crisp simple meaningful shapes.

concepts.name: 一拍节奏
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final standalone mobile app icon concept for oneBeat, delivered as ONE SQUARE 1024x1024 image.
oneBeat is a playful walking-together and synchronized rhythm practice app. Its established visual language is warm ivory #FFF9EE, near-black ink #171B1F, coral #FF7056, lavender #C5B7EB, teal #29B5AE, sky blue #A9C9F2, with confident hand-inked comic contours and tactile flat color.
Primary request: design a bold and unmistakable METRONOME brand emblem, expressing a single shared beat. A compact friendly tapered teal metronome body, one thick near-black diagonal pendulum with a large coral moving weight at the top, a warm ivory central face and simple ivory base detail. Show only TWO short curved black motion marks near the pendulum head to imply rhythmic swing. The silhouette should feel playful and lively, not technical or vintage. Warm ivory full-bleed square background; tiny lavender shadow accent is allowed under the emblem.
Style: premium flat hand-inked comic app identity, confident heavy slightly irregular near-black contours, clean solid shapes, an optional small hard offset shadow, minimal interior details. Readable instantly at 48 pixels. Main unified emblem occupies 72% of square, centered, avoiding all corner mask areas.
Constraints: all edges and four corners of the image remain fully square, no rounded outer corners or outer app-icon frame, no backdrop outside the canvas. ONE finished icon only. No text, numbers, letters, musical score, microscopic ticks, logos, watermark, collage, mockup, glossy 3D or gradients. Express a metronome, not a clock, not a play button.

concepts.name: 同拍小伙伴
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final standalone mobile app icon concept for oneBeat, delivered as ONE SQUARE 1024x1024 image.
oneBeat is a playful walking-together and synchronized rhythm practice app. Its established visual language is warm ivory #FFF9EE, near-black ink #171B1F, coral #FF7056, lavender #C5B7EB, teal #29B5AE, sky blue #A9C9F2, with confident hand-inked comic contours and tactile flat color.
Primary request: create a distinctive friendly icon portrait of the app's whimsical anthropomorphic TABLE-LAMP WALKER. Its head is a large golden yellow fabric lampshade with a strongly sloping trapezoidal silhouette, slightly tilted with lively character. Under the shade rim peeks a simple warm-ivory half-round face with TWO black oval curious eyes; a short dark lamp-stem neck and the shoulders of a sky-blue jacket with a single cream lapel hint. It is a humorous charming walking companion, not a robot. Crop as a large centered bust/portrait with the entire lampshade visible, silhouette strong at 48 pixels. Add TWO very small coral rhythmic motion ticks beside the shade if needed, but keep the image extremely uncluttered. Full-bleed TEAL square background.
Style: polished original hand-drawn indie-comic brand mascot, thick confident near-black outlines, flat mustard/cream/blue shapes with a FEW expressive ink hatching marks on the shade, not a detailed illustration. Warm approachable personality. Main portrait occupies about 74% of square and remains safe from future circle or squircle clipping; generous margin around lampshade rim.
Constraints: ONE actual standalone square app icon, every edge and all four corners square, background fills entire image, no rounded frame, no icon shown on a mockup. No words, letters, brand typography, watermark, multiple icons, photograph, 3D, elaborate lighting, scenery, full body, tiny props, or ornate texture.
